_note: Backlog for the semi-weekly SEO routine (seo/routine.md). Topics are ordered — the routine takes the first item with status 'todo', writes it as a content/blog-new/<slug>.js module, and flips it to 'done' with the date. Keyword targets came from Google Autocomplete on 2026-09-18 plus the SERP reads in the 2026-09 revamp; the medical and machinery clusters are deliberately front-loaded because those are the two paid themes carrying the budget.

clusters.medical: Highest priority. The site has only 2 medical posts against a service page that Google barely ranks. Commercial intent here lives in 'movers / moving company / relocation', NOT in device names — 'ct scanner' and 'mri machine' alone are consumer queries about cost and scan results.
clusters.machinery: Already well covered (9 posts). Fill genuine equipment gaps only, do not write another generic machinery post.
clusters.crane: Normal priority. Decision-stage queries convert better here than how-tos.
clusters.dispatch: Low priority by instruction — the brand should not read as a dispatch company. 3 posts is enough; only add if a query proves itself in Search Console.

queue.target: linear accelerator removal, linac relocation, linear accelerator rigging
queue.angle: Vault work: shielding, the maze, component sequence, OEM de-install, crane-in vs knock-out panel, decommissioning an old linac. Almost no competitor content exists on this and the jobs are large.

queue.target: x ray machine moving, radiography room relocation, c-arm moving
queue.angle: Fixed radiographic rooms, C-arms, fluoroscopy and mammo. Tube and detector handling, ceiling-suspended rails, lead-lined wall openings, working around a live department.

queue.target: hospital equipment movers, hospital equipment relocation, healthcare facility move
queue.angle: Department-level moves: who owns what between the OEM, biomed, EHS, facilities and the rigger. Decon sign-off, infection control risk assessment, elevator embargoes, night windows.

queue.target: medical equipment moving cost, mri move cost, what affects imaging equipment move price
queue.angle: Cost-factor piece with no prices — the same structure as the machinery-movers cost post that already ranks. Drivers: system weight and class, floor and route, OEM time, after-hours windows, wall work, distance.

queue.target: injection molding machine moving, molding machine rigging, press relocation
queue.angle: Real gap — the site covers CNC, lathes, mills and press brakes but not molding. Tie-bar and platen protection, splitting clamp and injection units, hopper and dryer systems, oil drain, leveling to tie-bar parallelism.

queue.target: switchgear installation companies, substation equipment moving, switchgear rigging
queue.angle: Autocomplete shows real demand for switchgear installation. Lineups moved in sections, bus alignment, pad and anchor tolerance, working around energized gear, coordination with the electrical contractor.

queue.target: crane rental with operator, crane service vs rigging company, who do I hire for a lift
queue.angle: Decision-stage post for the exact confusion the crane ad group runs into: renting steel and an operator versus hiring a crew that owns the whole pick. Where each one is correct.

queue.target: air compressor moving, industrial compressor relocation, rotary screw compressor move
queue.angle: Rotary screw and centrifugal units, receiver tanks and dryers, oil and condensate, vibration isolation pads, reconnecting plant air without leaks.

queue.target: forklift vs crane loading, machinery loading and unloading services, how to load a machine on a truck
queue.angle: Load-center derating on forklifts is the thing most people get wrong. When a forklift is right, when it is not, and what a crane pick or gantry changes.

queue.target: machine move site survey, rigging site survey, what riggers check before a move
queue.angle: AEO-shaped explainer of the site walk: weights and drawings, door and corridor measurements, floor loading, elevator ratings, utilities, the things that turn into change orders when they are skipped.

queue.target: data center relocation, server rack moving, data center rigging
queue.angle: The service page exists with no supporting guide. Rack roll-out vs de-stack, floor tile loading, ramps, shock monitoring, sequencing against a migration window.

queue.target: transformer moving company, indoor transformer rigging, transformer replacement
queue.angle: Distinct from the existing transport post: this is the rigging half. Getting a unit into an electrical room, skidding on steel, temporary steel, removing the old one, oil handling.
